title: The AI Infrastructure Control Layer
lede: Fonderie is the control layer for AI-built SaaS. It specifies, verifies, and standardizes every critical system — auth, billing, teams, permissions — so any AI assistant builds the same way every time. One platform. Any AI. Zero improvisation.

steps.title: You describe the product
steps.text: "I need a SaaS with login, Stripe billing, and team workspaces."

steps.title: Fonderie specifies the architecture
steps.text: The control layer defines exactly which systems to build and how they connect. Switch AI assistants anytime — the specification stays the same.

steps.title: Fonderie verifies the output
steps.text: Types, tests, and security checks run automatically. Every build is validated against the standard before it ships.

steps.title: You review and deploy
steps.text: You own the code. Customize the design, add your logic, deploy. Your backend is secure, your frontend works, and your customers can sign up and pay.
